model.scope: All ten speed-table indices; widths 0..20 plus overflow cases; eight scroll boundaries; both directions and equal pages. Independent full EWRAM/write-order/callback model; original/C final registers, flags, LR and IWRAM agree with synthetic caller-clobbering callbacks. Incoming NZCV cycles across cases.
model.limitations: Not byte-matching. Calls are synthetic and do not validate BG sync or Proc_Break implementations. No hardware timing, all-input flag Cartesian product, or arbitrary pointer aliases.

scope: Research receipt, not production C coverage. Byte similarity includes literals/alignment and is not a decompilation percentage.

rtl_findings.observation: At regmove output, instruction 200 shifts row pseudo 91 by six into pseudo 112 and marks pseudo 91 REG_DEAD. The shift remains a distinct pseudo assignment before allocation. Regmove inserts two-address copies for the AND operations; it does not collapse this shift assignment.
rtl_findings.next_step: Inspect local allocation quantity coalescing for the dead row input and shift output; operand-lifetime constraints tried here change section layout.

allocation_diagnostic_scope: Research compiler patch only. UID selectors are diagnostic, not an accepted production compiler contract. UID 401 disables reverse row/shift coalescing and fixes both reverse-loop differing halfwords. UID 200 disrupts broader allocation. Production and baseline C remain unchanged.
